definition: ἐπι-δέχομαι  [in LXX: Jdth.13:13 B2, 1Ma.10:1 1Mac 14:23, Sir.51:26, al. ;] __1. in cl., of things, to allow of, admit of (Dem., Arist., al.). In late writers,  __2. to accept besides (Polyb.), to accept (in π. of the terms of a lease; see ICC, on 3Jo, l.with): III Jn 9.  __3. (a) to receive besides (Menand.);  __(b) to receive hospitably (1Mac, Sir, ll with): III Jn 10†  (AS)
